title: Appendix 1. Interview Protocol
descriptions: Appendix 1 is an interview protocol used in our study as the data collection tool. The focus of the interview protocol is on teachers' feelings, thoughts, and emotions regarding digital technologies, as these were manifested in their personal and professional lives.
